title: Relative Ranks
description:
You are given an array score where each value is an athlete’s score.

All scores are unique
Higher score → better rank
Ranking Rules
Highest score → "Gold Medal"
2nd highest → "Silver Medal"
3rd highest → "Bronze Medal"
From 4th onward → "rank number" (as string)
Task

Return an array answer where:

answer[i] = rank of athlete at index i
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
output_format: Print space-separated rank strings in one line.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 10000
0 ≤ score[i] ≤ 10^6
All values are unique
